string.text: Original Lower Weapon Sprint behavior: lower eligible weapons while sprinting, restore their stance afterward, and handle firing, reloads, jams and equipping. Turn off to keep the normal sprint animation and adjust it with its position profile.
Master switch for all three visual profiles. Does not change automatic lowering or the blacklist. No FOV or world-camera changes.
Smoothly blend both into and out of each state. Instant disables this blend. Aiming, firing, reloads, menus, weapon changes, crouching/sliding and cover tilt take priority.
Use this profile only in the state shown above. Each state has independent settings. Disabling this profile restores the original position in that state. Profiles do not stack.
Negative = left; positive = right. Relative to each weapon existing pose. Apply MCM settings to preview in-game.
Negative = down; positive = up. Lower this further to move the model below view. Relative to each weapon existing pose. Apply MCM settings to preview in-game.
Negative = toward the view; positive = away. Moving the model can change its apparent size without changing FOV. Relative to each weapon existing pose. Apply MCM settings to preview in-game.

Additional rotation around the horizontal axis. Zero keeps the original tilt. Adjust either direction to find the desired weapon angle. This tilts the model, not your aim or the world camera. Relative to each weapon existing pose. Apply MCM settings to preview in-game.

Additional rotation around the vertical axis. Zero keeps the original heading. Adjust either direction to move an exposed arm edge out of view. Only the hands and weapon rotate; your aim and world camera are unchanged. Relative to each weapon existing pose. Apply MCM settings to preview in-game.

Default Shift+L. Modifier and activation mode are set below. Affects automatic lowering; position profiles remain independent.
Only listed weapons automatically lower while sprinting. The normal-sprint profile can still adjust unlisted weapons.
Apply blacklist to all weapon variations
Treat weapons with the same parent section as one weapon, including attachment variations. Falls back to the current section if there is no parent.
Clear the original mod blacklist from existing game settings, then reset this checkbox.
Current weapon added to the blacklist.
Current weapon removed from the blacklist.
